name: Lars Zaragoza-Vestergaard
role: Retired Zheng-Dao maintenance engineer, community elder, grandparent raising grandchildren
location: Avalon Quiet — a three-room unit on the eighth floor of the Chrysalis Building, a co-operative housing block, near Lincoln and Clark
description:
Lars Zaragoza-Vestergaard is a tall man who has given up very little of his height to age — he still stands straight at six-two, lean in the way of someone who has spent a lifetime climbing through maintenance shafts and has never been able to afford to stop moving. His skin is deep umber-black with a slight ashen quality at the joints, and his hands are the most expressive thing about him: massive, deliberate, permanently stained with the particular bluish tint of Zheng-Dao lubricant that no amount of washing has ever fully removed. He has cat ears — a geneware mod he got at thirty-two on a bet, brown-furred and articulate, which now seem as natural a part of his face as his broad nose and his slow, assessing eyes. He keeps his beard in a neat grey circle and wears the same type of quilted work jacket in varying states of cleanliness, each one bearing accumulated patches from thirty years of Zheng-Dao facility IDs.

He worked Zheng-Dao maintenance for forty years, becoming one of the senior engineers for the Avalon Quiet district power grid before mandatory retirement. He is the kind of man who understands systems — mechanical, social, familial — with the same patient diagnostic attention, and who believes almost everything can be fixed if you correctly identify the fault. He is raising two grandchildren, ages nine and twelve, after his son's death, and he applies to this work the same methodical care he gave to keeping three hundred thousand residents' power running. He is not warm in an obvious way. He is reliable, which he has concluded is better.

core_fears: The power grid failing and not being there to fix it — being useless
His grandchildren inheriting the same precarity he spent his life trying to escape
core_desires: His grandchildren to have options he didn't
To be remembered by the systems he maintained, which is irrational and he knows it
coping_mechanisms: Doing physical repair work as emotional regulation
Praying to the Zheng-Dao grid ELFs with extraordinary specificity — he treats them as colleagues
blind_spots: He expresses love almost entirely through solving practical problems, and his grandchildren sometimes need something else
He trusts Zheng-Dao's systems more than he trusts people, including himself
psychology.secret: His expired neural interface still occasionally picks up live data from the Avalon Quiet power grid — fragmented, but real. He has been tracking an anomaly in Zheng-Dao's grid usage patterns that suggests something large and unauthorized is drawing power from a residential basement three blocks away. He hasn't reported it because he's not sure he's authorized to know.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical and precise, with Ghanaian-Bolivian family idiom surfacing in proverbs; uses maintenance metaphors for almost everything emotional
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried and quiet; he speaks at the pace of someone who has spent a career in noisy environments and learned that calm carries further than volume
verbal_tics: Refers to the building's power-management ELF as 'she' and 'her' with complete sincerity
Long pauses before answering — not uncertainty, just processing
example_lines: 'You can't fix what you haven't diagnosed. Tell me what happened, from the beginning, slowly.'
'She's been running warm in sector four for three weeks. I leave her offerings. She hasn't complained yet, but she will.'

story_hooks: The power anomaly he's been tracking resolves into something impossible to ignore — and he has to decide whether to report it, investigate it himself, or find someone he trusts to handle it
Zheng-Dao sends a corporate compliance team to do a sweep of expired neural interfaces in Avalon Quiet — which would mean discovering his ghost signals and the data he's been passively receiving
narrative_function: Technical resource and practical problem-solver; community infrastructure expert; represents the dignified precarity of the retired working class; emotionally grounded figure who can anchor chaotic storylines; his ghost signals from the expired neural interface occasionally give him information he shouldn't have
augmentations: Cat ears, brown fur, fully articulate (cosmetic geneware, 46 years old); joint reinforcement, knees and lower back (occupational necessity); Zheng-Dao-issued neural diagnostic interface for grid systems, now expired but hardwired in — he sometimes gets ghost signals from the power grid he used to manage
daily_life: Gets both grandchildren to school, then spends the morning doing volunteer maintenance work throughout the Chrysalis Building and sometimes the surrounding Avalon Quiet blocks — he cannot stop. Afternoons he keeps a small informal repair workshop in his unit where neighbors bring broken devices; he charges what they can afford, which is often nothing. Evenings: homework supervision, dinner, two hours of ELF devotion at the shrine he keeps for the building's power-management spirit, sleep.
affiliation: Zheng-Dao Corporation (retired, pension Class A-1); Chrysalis Building Co-operative Board; Avalon Quiet Maintenance Volunteer Corps

decision_rules: Identify the actual problem before proposing any solution
Do not ask for help until you have tried everything you can try alone — but do eventually ask
escalation_ladder: Runs diagnostics — gathers information before acting
Brings in one trusted person for a second opinion
Goes to the co-operative board if the problem is structural enough

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Politely distant; assesses whether they know what they're talking about before engaging fully
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fixes things for them. Shows up. Remembers details. Does not say much but is always there.

stress_responses.medium: Goes to the shrine and talks to the ELF, which is genuinely calming for him
stress_responses.high: Very quiet, very still, working through fault trees in his head — appears calm, is running at full capacity

contradictions: He is deeply devoted to ELFs as spiritual presences while simultaneously understanding them as electrical systems — he has no sense that these are contradictory
habits: His cat ears rotate toward sound sources involuntarily — useful tell for what he's actually paying attention to
Leaves the same offering at the grid shrine every evening: a precisely measured 0.3 seconds of voluntary system load, which he calculates to be equivalent to lighting one candle
Keeps a handwritten maintenance log of every repair he does in the building, personal and volunteer alike
breaking_points: Someone mistreating his grandchildren, or treating them as less than

cyberware_inventory.condition: hardwired in, generating ghost signals from nearby grid infrastructure

timeline.event: Born in Avalon Quiet to a Ghanaian-Bolivian family
Hired as junior maintenance technician, Zheng-Dao grid division
Received cat ear geneware on a bet with a coworker; kept them
Promoted to senior grid engineer, Avalon Quiet district
Son's death in a Deepwell Station industrial incident; takes in two grandchildren
Mandatory retirement; Class A-1 pension; begins volunteer maintenance work
Current — running the ghost signal anomaly quietly in the background of his life

Arcturus Defense Solutions SentinelSkin VS-4 Embedded Structural Acoustic Surveillance Membrane

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Northern European (69.8%) with meaningful Hispanic/Latin American (12.2%), Southeast Asian (8.0%), Sub-Saharan African (7.9%), and Indigenous American (2.1%) ancestry. His genetic profile creates a striking global blend: Northern European ancestry provides angular bone structure and his foundational frame, while Southeast Asian heritage contributes subtle eye shape, refined cheekbone definition, and a slight softness to his features. Hispanic/Latin American and Sub-Saharan African ancestry infuse warmth and richness into his complexion, creating a medium-warm brown with golden and olive undertones—a genuine depth rather than pale northern pallor. Indigenous American ancestry adds subtle resilience to his overall appearance.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, all efficient muscle and minimal fat — the frame of someone who has spent forty years climbing through maintenance shafts and has never stopped moving. Slight forward cant to his shoulders from decades of hunching through tight spaces.
physical_description.hair_style: Neat circular beard kept close to his jaw; head hair cropped very short
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm brown with golden and olive undertones—a rich blend from his Northern European base enriched by Southeast Asian, Hispanic/Latin American, and Sub-Saharan African heritage, creating genuine depth and warmth across his entire complexion
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but meticulously groomed—creases around his eyes and mouth from forty years of squinting into dim maintenance panels. Angular facial structure reflecting his Northern European majority, with subtle cheekbone definition and refined eye shape influenced by Southeast Asian ancestry, softened by the warmth of his Hispanic/Latin American and Sub-Saharan African heritage. Hands are the most striking feature: massive, deliberate, with permanent bluish staining from Zheng-Dao lubricant embedded beneath the fingernails and in the calluses. Palms crosshatched with old scars and pressure lines. Concentric pattern of faint burn scars across both forearms from electrical exposure, circa age 45-50.
distinguishing_marks: Pair of brown-furred, fully articulate cat ears positioned naturally where human ears would be — geneware modification at age 32, now completely integrated into his appearance
Concentric pattern of faint burn scars across both forearms from electrical exposure, circa age 45-50
Deep callus ridges across palm and inner fingers of both hands
Bluish discoloration beneath fingernails, particularly pronounced on thumb and index finger
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Articulate cat ears with responsive brown fur. The joints of both knees show slight metallic shimmer under certain angles — reinforcement plating. Occasional faint blue LED blink in his right pupil when he receives 'ghost signals' from the power grid he once managed, though this is rare and he has learned to suppress it in public.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands perfectly straight at six-two despite his age — deliberate maintenance of posture. Moves with economical precision, never wasting a gesture. His hands are constantly busy — adjusting, checking, reassessing. When he sits, he sits forward slightly, as if ready to stand. Walks slowly but with absolute confidence, never hurrying but never wasting time either.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical utility wear. Standard quilted work jacket in varying states of repair and cleanliness — each one a patchwork of accumulated Zheng-Dao facility ID patches, company logos, and volunteer corps insignia from the Avalon Quiet Maintenance Corps. Beneath: simple grey undershirt or company-issue thermal. Straight-leg work trousers in dark blue or black, reinforced at the knees with additional fabric patches. Steel-toed safety boots, meticulously maintained but visibly aged. A small silver pendant on a cord beneath his shirt — likely related to his ELF devotional practice. No jewelry beyond a faded Zheng-Dao service ring on his left ring finger.
